title: 第25章 尘埃落定第26章 华章浩汽
content_zh:
夫子一怒，仙塾内外为之震动。
“起阵，去！”
葛仙师不知何时已然出现，单手一扬，一杆三角小幡飞到空中，落下一道金色圆罩，当空落下，将仙塾内外围得密不透风，苍蝇都飞不出去。
“啊！”周厉化作的黑云迎头撞上，顿时残呼一声，倒飞而回，露出一张头破血流的狰狞面孔。
“周厉，你妄为仙塾学子，竟敢养鬼害人，今日留你不得！”
老夫子须发皆张，右手虚虚一握。
先天一炁大擒拿！
灵气返先天之炁，为气中之王，破体而出，调动天地四散灵纷纷汇聚而来，化作一张五指山凭空抓下。
那团黑云落于掌中，如落入佛掌中的猴子，被死死攥在掌心，逃脱不得。
黑烟剧烈冲击五指山的束缚，发出周厉惊恐的嘶吼：“老东西，放开我！”
“还想挣扎？残害同门，修炼邪法，留你不得！”老夫子眼神冰冷，五指缓缓收紧。
只听“噗”的一声，黑烟中传来骨骼碎裂的闷响，随即彻底消散，只余下几滴黑血落在青石板上，发出滋滋的腐蚀声。
老夫子望着地上那滩还在冒烟的黑血，藜杖在掌心转了半圈，语气里带着惋惜，更多的却是痛恨：“痴儿！仙途漫漫，本该步步为营，他偏要走这旁门左道，为了个仙籍名额，竟不惜残害同门，炼那子母鬼……”
葛仙师走上前，拂过血迹的指尖沾了点黑灰，眉头微皱：“夫子下手未免太急了些。好歹留他一口气，审一审背后还有没有同党，就这么让他死了，倒是便宜了他。”
老夫子闻言皱眉，抬手看了看自己的掌心，那里还残留着捏碎邪祟的滞涩感：“我本没想取他性命，只想擒来问罪。谁知他先前似是早已受重伤，又强行催动血遁，根基早已崩碎。我那一下，不过是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草罢了。”
“早受重伤！”葛仙师愣了愣，只见那周厉所逃离的方向，心中暗忖，“那不是吴燃灯的住处吗？此子竟已有了如此手段，能正面击退转炼魔修功力大进的周厉，真是后生可畏！”
而作为当事人，吴燃灯恰在时候的出现，见到周厉尸骨难保，暗暗松了一口气。
望着老夫子收势落地，他躬身行礼：“多谢夫子出手。”
老夫子目光落在他身上，又扫过他周身残留的符文灵气，微微点头，“周厉之事，我已知晓。你做得不错，邪祟之辈，法不容情。”
他顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝赞许，又补充道：“你那符章之术，刚正精纯，倒是难得。今夜除了周厉这祸害，你功不可没。”

“有过当罚，有功当赏！”葛仙师亦点头，“以炼气修为，能逼得周厉动用血遁，还能识破画皮诡计，心性手段，都远超同辈。这桩案子能破，吴燃灯你对仙塾有大功，看来我等师长今日不得不表示表示了。”
老夫子在旁想了想，从袖中取出一卷蓝布封皮的经卷，递了过去：“听闻你常读道经，这卷《周游六虚罡煞经》是秘传道经之一，注解灵气炼化精髓，更能辨识后续境界的天罡地煞之气，送你参详。
要知道古之炼气士，不求境界，只炼胸口一气，采煞炼罡，亦能达到天人造化之境，不缺飞升大能。只是事随世移，炼气士之路如今早已走不通了，只有炼气奥妙，仍值得后来者参详。”
“多谢夫子！”吴燃灯真诚谢过，这一卷《周游六虚罡煞经》参详之后，对炼气精纯有着大用。
可见老夫子是看准了，才赐予他的，用心不可谓良苦。
“夫子如此大方，我也不得不表示了。”葛仙师也取出一卷，封皮泛黄的经文拓本：“我这卷《易术风水灵咒》，以易阐述真言灵咒之道，虽偏于术数，但符法、灵咒不分家，对你易数、符法都有触类旁通之效。”
吴燃灯双手接过，指尖触到经卷的温润，忙躬身谢道：“多谢夫子，多谢仙师。”
又是两卷秘传道经到手，让他心情大好。
仙业在手，资源不缺，唯有这种仙凡隔绝的知识正是他当前最需要的。
吴燃灯高兴之余，顿了顿，又道，“只是今夜之事，还请二位师长莫要对外宣扬我的存在，学生只想安心备战仙籍，以免俗事烦扰。”
老夫子闻言抚须而笑：“难得你有这份沉潜心性。如今的年轻弟子，多是急着显露锋芒，你能如此低调，实属可贵。”
葛仙师亦颔首：“放心，此事我等知晓便好。你且回去歇息，道经好生研读，于你修行大有裨益。”
content_en:
The master was so angry that the school was shaken both inside and outside.
"Get into formation and go!"
Master Ge Xian appeared at some point, raised one hand, and a small triangular flag flew into the air, and dropped a golden round shield. It fell in the air, making the inside and outside of the Immortal School airtight, so that no flies could fly out.
"Ah!" The black cloud that Zhou Li transformed into hit him head-on. He let out a scream and flew back, revealing a ferocious face with a broken head and blood.
"Zhou Li, you are a student of an immortal school and you dare to raise ghosts and harm people. I won't let you stay today!"
The old master's beard and hair are spread out, and his right hand is weakly held.
Innately capable of capturing!
The spiritual energy returned to the innate Qi, and became the king of energy. It broke out of the body, mobilized the scattered spirits in the world to gather together, and turned into a five-finger mountain to grab out of thin air.
The black cloud fell in the palm, like a monkey falling into the palm of the Buddha. It was tightly held in the palm and could not escape.
The black smoke violently hit the restraints of Wuzhishan, causing Zhou Li to scream in horror: "Old man, let me go!"
"Still want to struggle? You're not allowed to leave your fellow disciples and practice evil methods!" The old master's eyes were cold and his fingers slowly tightened.
There was only a "pop" sound, and the muffled sound of broken bones came from the black smoke, and then completely dissipated, leaving only a few drops of black blood falling on the bluestone, making a sizzling sound of corrosion.
The old master looked at the pool of black blood that was still smoking on the ground. He turned the quinoa staff in half a circle in the palm of his hand. There was regret in his tone, but more of it was hatred: "Idiot! The road to immortality is long and should be done step by step, but he insists on taking this heretical path. In order to get a place in the immortal registration, he is willing to kill his fellow disciples and train that child mother ghost..."
Master Ge Xian stepped forward, brushing the blood on his fingertips with some black ash, and frowned slightly: "Master, it was too hasty to start. At least let him breathe, and check whether there are any accomplices behind him. Let him die like this, which will be an advantage for him."
The old master frowned when he heard this, and raised his hand to look at his palm, where the sluggish feeling of crushing the evil spirit still remained: "I didn't want to take his life, I just wanted to capture him and hold him accountable. Who knew that he seemed to have been seriously injured before, and he forced the blood escape, and his foundation had already collapsed. That was just the straw that broke the camel's back."
"Seriously injured!" Master Ge Xian was stunned for a moment. He only saw the direction Zhou Li was escaping from, and thought to himself, "Isn't that Wu Randeng's residence? This guy actually has such means, and can defeat Zhou Li who has greatly improved his demon-refining skills. He is really a formidable young man!"
As the person involved, Wu Randeng showed up at the right time and secretly breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Zhou Li's body could not be saved.
Watching the old master retreat and land on the ground, he bowed and saluted: "Thank you for taking the initiative, master."
The old master's eyes fell on him, and then he scanned the remaining rune aura around him, and nodded slightly, "I already know about Zhou Li. You did a good job, evil people will not be merciful."
He paused, a hint of approval flashed in his eyes, and added: "Your talisman skills are upright and pure, which is rare. You are indispensable for the scourge of Zhou Li tonight."
"Those who have committed crimes should be punished, and those who have merited should be rewarded!" Master Ge Xian also nodded. "With his Qi refining skills, he can force Zhou Li to use blood escape, and he can also see through the tricks of painting. His temperament and methods are far superior to those of his peers. This case can be solved. Wu Randeng, you have made great contributions to the Immortal School. It seems that we, the teachers, have to express your gratitude today."
The old master thought for a while, then took out a blue cloth-covered sutra from his sleeve and handed it over: "I heard that you often read Taoist scriptures. This volume, "Wandering around the Six Void Gangsha Sutra", is one of the secret Taoist scriptures. It annotates the essence of spiritual energy refining and can better identify the Tiangang and Earthsha Qi in subsequent realms. I send it to you for your reference.
We must know that the ancient Qi practitioners did not seek realms, but only refined the Qi in their chests, collected evil spirits and refined Gang, and they could also reach the realm of creation between heaven and man, and they did not lack the power of ascension. It's just that things have changed with the times, and the path of Qi Refining Master has long been blocked. Only the secret of Qi Refining is still worth studying for those who come after. "
"Thank you, Master!" Wu Randeng sincerely thanked him. This volume "Traveling Around the Six Virtual Realms"After reading the "Gangsha Sutra" in detail, it is of great use in refining Qi and making it pure.
It can be seen that the old master saw it correctly and gave it to him, and his intentions were not good.
"Master is so generous, I have to express it." Master Ge Xian also took out a volume of scripture rubbings with a yellowed cover: "My volume "Yi Shu Feng Shui Spiritual Mantra" explains the mantra and mantra in Yi Yi. Although it is biased towards magic, the talismans and spiritual mantras are not separated. It will have an analogous effect on your Yi Shu and talismans."
Wu Randeng took it with both hands, his fingertips touched the warmth of the scroll, and he hurriedly bowed and thanked: "Thank you, Master, and Master Immortal."
He got two more volumes of secret scriptures, which made him feel very good.
Immortal industry is in hand and there is no shortage of resources. Only this kind of knowledge isolated from the immortal world is what he needs most at the moment.
When Wu Randeng was happy, he paused and said, "It's just for tonight. Please don't publicize my existence to the outside world. The students just want to prepare for the Immortal Book in peace to avoid being disturbed by worldly matters."
When the old master heard this, he stroked his beard and smiled: "It's rare for you to have such a deep concentration. Today's young disciples are mostly eager to show their talents. It's really valuable that you can be so low-key."
Master Ge Xian also nodded: "Don't worry, it will be good if we know about this. You can go back and have a rest. Studying the Taoist scriptures will be of great benefit to your practice."
